sources.note: Reported 15-year gas sale agreement, dated November 5th. Reported, not signed. No ratepayer impact is STAK's claim.

sources.title: Dunleavy pushes for data centers to come to Alaska as he prepares to leave office
sources.note: Governor-elect said he would support a moratorium on data center construction in Alaska. A statement of support, not tied to STAK.
